welcome: Welcome, {name} ✨ 🎬 Media Downloader Download public TikTok and Instagram videos, Stories, images and carousels — one link or a complete batch. A premium experience: • Send one or several links together • Pick one quality for video media • Track every item and receive all supported media 🔒 Privacy first — files are removed after delivery.
blocked: Access to this bot has been disabled for your account.
home: Your dashboard is ready. What would you like to do?
send_link:
✨ Send one or several public TikTok or Instagram links here.
I’ll detect every platform and prepare the quality options.
batch.prompt: 📚 Batch Download Center Send up to {max} public TikTok or Instagram links in one message. Put each link on a separate line, then choose one quality for the entire batch. You can cancel the full batch at any time and will receive a final result summary.
batch.detected:
✅ Detected {count} unique supported links.
Choose one quality for the entire batch:
help: 💡 How it works 1️⃣ Copy one public link — or several links for batch mode 2️⃣ Send them in one message 3️⃣ Choose quality 4️⃣ Follow live progress and receive every media item 🎬 Supported platforms 🎵 TikTok — public videos 📸 Instagram — Reels, Stories, video posts, images and carousels Stories and login-gated public media require the optional Instagram cookies configuration. Private content is never bypassed.
settings: 🛠️ Settings Customize your download experience and language below.
privacy: 🔒 Privacy & security • We process public links only and never bypass private accounts. • The bot never asks users for passwords or sign-in details. • An optional owner-configured Instagram session can be used for Stories; it is loaded only at runtime and never shown to users. • Temporary media files are automatically removed after delivery when enabled. • We do not sell your data or use it for advertising. • Basic operational statistics, such as download count and platform, may be stored. Only download content you have the right to use.
history_empty: 🕘 Download history No downloads yet. Send your first link to get started.
progress: ⏳ Downloading {progress_bar} {percent}% Keep this chat open — I’ll send the file as soon as it’s ready.
invalid_url: ❌ Please send a valid TikTok or Instagram link only.
rate_limit:
⏳ You have reached the temporary download limit.
Please try again shortly.
duplicate: ⏳ This link is already being processed.
busy: ⏳ You already have a download in progress. Please wait.
too_large: ⚠️ This video is larger than the limit for direct Telegram delivery.
download_failed:
❌ Could not download this video right now.
Check that the link is for a public video or Reel, then try again.
download_access:
⚠️ Instagram requires an authenticated session for this media.
Make sure it is public and configure INSTAGRAM_COOKIES_BASE64 for Stories and login-gated public posts.
download_rate_limited:
⏱️ The platform is temporarily rate-limiting requests.
Wait a little, then try again.
download_unavailable:
⚠️ The platform changed or temporarily blocked this media response.
Make sure the link is public and try again later.
